blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Marcos on Tuesday announced that an undersea power cable will soon be laid between Sabah in Malaysia and Mindanao. Marcos said this is in line with the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean)’s memorandum of understanding (MOU) on the Asean Power Grid. The MOU provides important institutional planning and regulatory foundations
